meta.coverage: urban and outer-suburban New South Wales only
honesty: Ranks by how far a region sits above its own long-run speed. A random forest scored no better inside an inspection budget, so the simpler rule is the one deployed.
Predicts a fall of at least 20% that is still there a quarter later. Two thirds of single-quarter falls undo themselves.
Regional New South Wales is absent: 94% of its region-quarters lack the history the model needs, so this covers urban and outer-suburban areas only.
Four quarters ahead scores as well as one, so this recognises a standing condition rather than a developing fault. It says which regions, never when.
